# Feature 1: Price bucket relative to user behavior - log of price normalized
df['log_price'] = np.log1p(df['price'])

# Feature 2: Price to product_id ratio - captures price per product unit identifier
df['price_per_product'] = df['price'] / (df['product_id'] + 1)

# Feature 3: User-price interaction - captures spending pattern per user segment
df['user_price_interact'] = df['user_id'] * np.log1p(df['price'])

# Feature 4: Price squared (non-linear price effect - high price items may have different event patterns)
df['sq_price'] = df['price'] ** 2

# Feature 5: Category-price ratio - captures price positioning within category space
# category_id is very large, so normalize it first
df['category_price_ratio'] = np.log1p(df['price']) / (np.log1p(df['category_id']) + 1)
